arStrings.szText: {c_important}Heaven's Fury{/c} splits into {c_number}3{/c} beams, dealing {c_number}{payload:BEAM_TRIPLE_PAYLOAD}{/c} damage each hit for {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Heaven's Fury{/c} splits into {c_number}{SF_30}{/c} orbiting beams, dealing {c_number}{payload:PROJECTILE_DAMAGE_B}{/c} damage each hit for {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Heaven's Fury{/c} can Cast anywhere, concentrating the Light as it grows and Pulls enemies in while dealing {c_number}{payload:NUKE_PERIODIC}{/c} damage per second before erupting for {c_number}{payload:NUKE_DETONATION}{/c} damage. 

{c_important}Heaven's Fury's{/c} Cooldown is increased by {c_number}{SF_35}{/c} seconds.
